title: MediaProfile
description: An OfflineMediaDownloader account profile: the signed-in user plus aggregate library metrics, as shown on the profile screen. Fixture pool for OMD profile previews (S98). All identity values are synthetic (see SCRUBBING.md).

user.title: MediaUser
user.description: Signed-in user identity as delivered by Sign in with Apple registration.

metrics.title: MediaMetrics
metrics.description: Aggregate library metrics computed from local persistence.

downloadCount.description: Number of files downloaded to the device.

totalStorageBytes.description: Total on-device storage used by downloads, in bytes.

playCount.description: Total playback sessions across the library.
